name: open-air-cinema-v3
label: Открытый бумажный мир
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a new art-directed full-page DESKTOP website design based on reference 1, not a copy. Deliver ONE tall 1:3 image showing the entire page, header to footer, approximately 1280x3840. Not a mobile layout, poster, moodboard or device mockup.
The user likes the delightful paper world and outdoor cinema but finds the supplied page MUCH TOO CROWDED. The new design must be noticeably MORE SPACIOUS. Keep all content, use smaller artwork, twice the breathing room, broad quiet backgrounds, wide gutters, clean separation. About HALF the page should be unoccupied calm background. Do not pack decorations into every gap. No large leaf borders, trailing vines, cushions, lanterns, kitchen paraphernalia, scattered grains, flowers everywhere, crowns, game numbering, or repeated character cameos.
Reference 1 = liked previous page, visual vocabulary ONLY, NOT a composition/density template. Reference 2 = approved paper material/world. Reference 3 = brown-haired boy identity, cream sun shirt, green shorts, cream sneakers. Reference 4 = slightly taller girl identity, pale-pink bob, daisy clip, yellow dress, green sandals. Reference 5 = simple paper food shapes. Keep exact characters, European picture-book style, no anime or toddler proportions. Matte FLAT cut-paper shapes, quiet sparse fibers, short contact shadows. Food also flat and simple, no photographic crust, glossy ceramics, sculpted 3D, clay, all-over grain or embossing.
Represent a wide desktop: central content column stops growing at an equivalent 1440 within a 1920-wide page. Quiet side gutters about 12.5% on BOTH sides. Background colors continue edge to edge naturally. Important art never at viewport edges. Do not print these technical dimensions or rem specifications.
CONTENT, all visible:
Header: small plate logo «Три друга» and «Смотреть», «Играть», «Семейное меню», «Взрослым». No search/social icons.
Hero: «Три друга на тарелке», small «Истории и игры о еде · 8–12 лет», buttons «Смотреть мультфильм», «Выбрать игру», one contained shared scene with boy and girl assembling food, one bubble «Тосту скучно одному!».
Groups: «Кого позовём на тарелку?» with «Овощи и фрукты», «Крупы и хлеб», «Белок». One readable modest plate diagram or three modest food arrangements, ample blank space.
Films: «Смотрим истории». A magical but sparse dusk cinema. One main landscape preview «Три друга на тарелке» — «68 секунд» plus two SMALL previews «Сад в животе» — «27 секунд», «Ужин: слушай живот» — «26 секунд». Clear play controls, a tiny crescent and at most 3–5 warm lights; no surrounding forest enclosure or furniture.
Games: «Пробуем сами», small «Ошибаться можно — герои подскажут». Exactly SEVEN entries: «Собери тарелку», «Паровозик и сад», «Ланч-бокс для друга», «Что в блюде?», «Правда или миф», «Что говорит живот?», «Собери перекус». One small paper activity illustration, readable title and tiny arrow per entry. Quiet similar surfaces, generous gaps, no multiple badges/buttons or scenery behind cards.
Menu: «Продолжим дома», «Что приготовить завтра?», three small-to-medium dishes titled «Сырники с ягодами», «Плов с курицей», «Рыба с картошкой», button «Все 45 блюд и заготовки». No kitchen room around them.
Adults: «Родителям и учителям», light accordion rows «Нужно ли доедать?», «Как говорить о еде?», «На что мы опираемся?», link «Источники». No extra vignette.
Compact forest-green footer, brand/navigation only.
Balsamiq-like expressive but restrained headings, Nunito-like readable UI, clean Russian Cyrillic. Characters only in hero and actual video previews. Main art should be about 65% of the previous RELATIVE size, generous padding around every group. No AI/tool labels, medical claims, fake endorsements or extra functions. Keep joy, color and paper craft; do not make a sterile corporate landing page.

DIRECTION A. A storybook page with an OPEN pale-blue sky hero, very low distant hill, one contained medium scene at right, bold heading left. Intro uses one modest plate and three readable labels on ample ivory. Cinema is the only dark immersive section: flat midnight-teal band with plenty of blank sky, one main screen left and two small episode previews right; a sparse 3-bulb light string at top. Games on very pale sage: a four-column grid, first game spans two rows, other six in 3 columns x 2 rows, generous gaps and SMALL art. Menu on quiet peach with three independent dishes, wide gaps. Adults plain ivory. Only two or three flowing paper section edges across the whole page. Keep scenery minimal; no plant wall framing the layout. WARM, AIRY, STORY-LIKE.
